newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Air NZ eyes United alliance - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Air NZ eyes United alliance - paper.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd is looking at an possible alliance with United Airlines, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Wednesday.

"United is a major factor in internatonal aviation and the alliance it belongs to is a critical contributor to inbound tourism to this part of the globe," Air New Zealand government and bilateral affairs manager Irene King was quoted as saying.
However, King said after an aviation conference in Canberra that that Air New Zealand was having discussions with a range of carriers and that she could not comment specifically.
Air New Zealand said earlier this month it would announce an alliance with another airline in either Asia, the United States or Europe within weeks.
